cc:Work.dc:description: Marker area encodes 2K/4K/8K budget (small/medium/large); concentric points overlap. 1K is omitted here because Proposed did not execute. Sources: docs/results/main_20261109/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/main-final-analysis-2026-11-09.md
